purpose: Focused pre-Unity cinematic-intent checks for CURRENT V5 output. These rules do not replace Unity validation and do not claim runtime correctness.

rules.description: compositionTargetId is non-empty but the target has no visible/present evidence anywhere in the shot.
rules.notes: A target is legal when it is visible initially or enters/reveals during the shot. Empty compositionTargetId is preferable to a false Hero fallback.

rules.description: A camera action targets an entity that has no visible/present evidence during the camera action interval.
rules.notes: Do not warn when the entity legally enters/reveals during the same action interval.

rules.description: Fine-grained expression and coarse Stage/Delivery emotion disagree with the deterministic projection.
rules.notes: Expression is the visual source of truth. Stage/Delivery are coarse projections and are not required to contain the same literal.

rules.description: preserveScreenDirection=true but matchedEntityIds is empty even though the shot contains continuity-bearing moving/present entities.
rules.notes: Do not warn on empty/static/location-only shots where no continuity subject exists.

rules.description: A cinematic/action movement is materialized as a straight Move with no keyframes or trajectory evidence.
rules.notes: Use this for semantically meaningful movement such as flyby, approach, orbit, intercept, bank, pursuit, escort, formation break, rescue approach, circle, landing, takeoff, escape or convoy motion.

rules.description: Dialogue switches to portrait-only presentation while the shot intention or visible plan depends on important world evidence that is not represented by the dialogue stage.
rules.notes: FACE_TO_FACE_PORTRAITS is legal when the intended shot genuinely leaves the world. Prefer overlay/monitor/environment routes when threat/location/action context must remain visible.

rules.description: Three or more consecutive dialogue shots reuse effectively the same background, layout, framing, camera preset and transition.
rules.notes: Cinematic warning only, never a schema/runtime blocker.

rules.description: The shot intention makes a major physical story claim but the V5 shot contains no corresponding actor/layer/effect/action evidence.
rules.notes: Physical events are not satisfied by prose in intention. This browser rule is intentionally conservative and may require Unity-side semantic evidence for final truth.
